title: Engineering huddle: OAuth2 migration confirmed
content: Decision from today's payment huddle: all Payment Service internal calls move from JWT to OAuth2 client credentials. JWT support remains only for legacy read-only endpoints until September.
author: Priya Raman

title: PR #482: Add OAuth2 middleware to payment-service
content: Merged OAuth2 client credential validation middleware for payment-service. JWT validator moved behind a legacy compatibility flag.
author: Sanjay P

title: Release process changed to Tuesday/Thursday
content: Starting this sprint, customer-facing deployments move from Friday evening to Tuesday and Thursday noon windows. QA sign-off remains mandatory.
author: Meera S

title: Enterprise onboarding ownership moved to Implementation Squad
content: For enterprise customers above Rs. 25L annual contract value, Implementation Squad now owns onboarding from kickoff to go-live. Customer Success remains accountable for relationship health.
author: Nisha M

title: SRE-223: Validate Sev1 postmortem SLA
content: Confirmed incident policy remains correct. Sev1 postmortem SLA is still 48 hours and escalation list is unchanged.
author: Karthik V
